messages:
Evelyn: Who took the 'departed but always caffeinated' mug from my desk? It has tiny stickers of planets on it.
Ravi: Wait THAT mug has been living a double life on the 5th floor kitchenette for a week. I thought it was community property.
Noah: I assumed it was part of the 'mystery dishware' collection. There's a sticky note that says "Do Not Worship" so I left it alone.
Tori: This is escalating into a full-blown artifact recovery. Anyone want to form a search party?
Evelyn: Search party yes. Also reward: one homemade banana bread slice + eternal gratitude.
SnackBot: Logistics: banana bread will be available in kitchen at 4pm if recovered.
Ravi: We should probably do a provenance investigation. Timeline: 1) Last seen on Eve's desk 2) Sighted by OpsBot at 10:12 in meeting room B 3) Spotted near printer at 10:37.
OpsBot: I confirm visual ping from motion sensor #3 at 10:36: "small ceramic object moved". (sensor log id: ms-3-189123)
Noah: Evidence mounting that the mug is an itinerant traveler. Maybe it's trying to unionize with other mugs.
Tori: Petition to give the mug a backstory. I propose: "Mugulus, Voyager of Mornings, Protector of Stains."
Evelyn: Love it. If returned, Mugulus should receive a tiny flag and a snack.
Ravi: Poll time: Return to owner, Keep as community mug, Or hold a trial in the breakroom. React :one: :two: :three: to vote.
SnackBot: Poll created: "What to do with Mugulus?"  React with :one: (return) :two: (community) :three: (trial).
Noah: Also found a sticky note inside the mug that says `If found, please free the succulents.`
Tori: That's suspicious. Who was planning to liberate plants?
Evelyn: Okay that's the clincher. It's definitely mine. I put that exact passive-aggressive note last month when I was feeling dramatic.
Ravi: Mystery solved. Sorry for the unconsented mug vacation. Bringing it back now.
Noah: Can we organize a ceremonial handoff? Photo op required.
Evelyn: Please include a small oath: "I will not borrow thy mug without leaving a Post-it of tribute."
SnackBot: Reminder: kitchen camera is off between 3:30-3:35 for maintenance. No photos during maintenance window.
Tori: Handoff is at 3:45 by the mini ficus. Whoever shows up with the mug gets a free coffee on me.
Ravi: Arriving with the mug and a tiny flag. Also I knit a scarf for it.
Evelyn: Thank you! Bonus points if scarf matches planets motif.
Noah: If Mugulus decides to wander again, we start a support group for rogue dishware. Agenda: snacks, bylaws, name tags.
Evelyn: See you at 3:45. And yes, bring a camera (outside maintenance window). Long live Mugulus.
